name: Mail Concierge
description: Mail Concierge lets administrators invite people by e-mail, lets users recover their password by e-mail and, if the administrator allows it, sign in with their e-mail address, without any change to Jellyfin itself.
overview: E-mail invitations, e-mail password recovery and sign-in by e-mail address for Jellyfin

versions.changelog: Links in e-mails carry their token after a hash sign so it stays out of server logs; a Live TV checkbox on each invitation (off by default); the plugin starts turned off and refuses to be enabled until the public URL, the SMTP server and the sender are valid; SMTP provider list (Gmail, Brevo, SMTP2GO, Mailgun, Mailjet); invitation history as a table with status, access and filters; e-mail logo setting; e-mail counters in the settings; clearer public pages. If e-mails stop after the update, check the SMTP server (name only), port and sender in the settings. Needs Jellyfin 12.4; Jellyfin 12.1 to 12.3 stay on 12.0.0.0.
Sign in with your confirmed e-mail address (off by default), and a series of security and reliability fixes; this release needs Jellyfin 12.4. Jellyfin 12.1 to 12.3 stay on 12.0.0.0.
First public release: e-mail invitations, e-mail password recovery, e-mail address in the profile, optional Seerr synchronisation, English, French, Spanish and German.
